patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..5c7c189 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -445,6 +445,17 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
         attempt_id = state.next_completion_attempt
         state.candidate_digest = None
 
+        # Once a completion proposal is submitted, verification and review are
+        # harness overhead. Do not let them be rejected solely because the
+        # isolated checks run past the executor wall-clock deadline.
+        state.deadline_monotonic = max(
+            state.deadline_monotonic,
+            self._clock()
+            + sum(check.timeout_sec for check in decision.checks)
+            + self._options.max_model_call_timeout_sec
+            + MODEL_CALL_SHUTDOWN_RESERVE_SEC,
+        )
+
         async def execute_check(
             check: VerificationCheck,
             environment: ShellEnvironment,
